content:
The **Black Powder Rifle** is a non-automatic rifle in *Fallout 76*.

## Gameplay[edit]

Produced in 1850 in Harpers Ferry, [1] the weapon makes use of .50 Caliber Balls as ammunition and deals +50% damage to limbs. It has a unique reloading animation that involves the player character using a ramrod to push a lead ball down the rifle's barrel.

### Modifications[edit]

## Locations[edit]

- Can be crafted after buying the relevant plan from Flintlock inside the Whitespring Resort.
- Oce can be found at the Philippi Battlefield Cemetery, inside the museum in a display case along with other weapons and outfits.
- One can be found at Prickett's Fort, in a display case in one of the cabins near the parking lot.
- One can be found at the Garrahan Estate, in a level 1-locked display case on the third floor.
- One can be found at Harper's Ferry on the east side in a small building. On the left as one travels from the fast travel location.
- One can be found at the back of Dark Hollow Manor on the second floor within an opening in the collapsed wall, under some rubble in front of a revolutionary war painting.
- Randomly found in Government Aid Drops.

PC

![Xbox One](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/e/e2/Icon_xboxone.png/14px-Icon_xboxone.png) Playstation 4

![Playstation 4](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/6/6f/Icon_ps4.png/18px-Icon_ps4.png) Blackpowder rifles received an update that changed their modification behavior, but did not retroactively adjust existing blackpowder rifles. Any blackpowder rifle from before this update will have 204 range and cannot be equipped with a skin.
